owners: Golden document selection and color metadata

Header labels have no duplicate selection outlines; playback markers remain independent

matrix_rust_tests.scope: Includes color edit permission, Undo/Redo, nested copies and sparse project reload. Test-only TAURI_CONFIG removes bundle resources to avoid overwriting DLLs held by the user's development app; no packaging claim from this test invocation.
